w: Re-ruled at B4a-05 under J's rulings of 13 October: T3-073, which no placement held, is removed. 'i was working on it but it got wiped out. only the maryland flag has bee able to withstand the swedish flag' and 'MD holding strong' report the attack and the line held, which T3-005's must_show takes ('holding the line'; both readers held both there), with 'Damn swedes thinking they can overrule us' and 'r/steelers is trying to destroy the Ravens logo. q: Defence and repair: T3-005 when the attack and the fight lead, T3-021 when the watching and fixing do; tracing who attacked in concepts of its own adds T3-087.
w: Re-ruled at B4a-05 under J's rulings of 13 October: T3-065, which no placement held, is removed. 'Samo da je odrzavamo da nam drugi ne zamene kockice' (just maintain it so others do not replace our squares), 'braco srbi, probajte je popravljati dok nije kasno!' (Serb brothers, try to repair it before it is too late), 'jebu nam se s grbom, popravljajmo' (they are fucking with our crest, let's repair), 'Drzite se originalnih dimenzija i popravljajte sto trolovi useru' and repairing the little tricolour that vandals were trying 'bugarizovati ili arapizovati' (to make Bulgarian or Arab) keep and repair the work, which T3-021's must_show takes (reader A and my B1). 'Kvare nam zastavu, u pomoc!' (they are spoiling our flag, help!), 'Branite zastavu!' (defend the flag!) and 'Руше нам заставу, помозите нам одбранити' (they are tearing down our flag, help us defend it) fight attacks (T3-005, both readers). The two tie at ten concepts and two placements each, and T3-005's decide_when_both does not say which leads when they tie. Fighting 'sa pokatoličenim Srbima' (with Catholicised Serbs, a slur for Croats) is one concept.
